name: handoff lock acquisition never reclaims an old live lock

source.assertion:
assert_equals "handoff lock acquisition never reclaims an old live lock" \
  "rc=1 lock=retained" \
  "rc=$handoff_rc lock=$([ -d "$lock_dir" ] && printf retained || printf removed)"

stdin:
oso-handoff: v=1 slice=slice-lock attempt=1
status: done
